Every freelancer knows the gut-punch: a fat client check hits your account, you spend it like it's all yours, and then April arrives with a tax bill you never saved for. SetAside fixes that the simple way our grandparents did — with a jar. SetAside is a virtual tax jar for 1099 and self-employed income. Each time you get paid, you log the deposit and SetAside instantly skims your chosen set-aside rate — 25%, 30%, whatever fits your bracket — into a tax jar you don't touch.
